description: Get all activities related to a specific CRM object via association graph
fromSql: SELECT a.*, r.crm_ar_role FROM mt_crm_activity_common a JOIN mt_crm_activity_relation_common r ON a.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE r.crm_ar_object_type = #{params.objectType} AND r.crm_ar_object_id = #{params.objectId} AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY a.crm_act_date DESC

name:zh-CN: 按直接关联对象查任务
description: Get task activities directly anchored to a workspace object via crm_act_related_model and crm_act_related_id
fromSql: SELECT a.*, a.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS crm_act_status, a.crm_act_ext->>'priority' AS crm_act_priority, NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date AS crm_act_due_date, a.crm_act_ext->>'assignee' AS crm_act_assignee FROM mt_crm_activity_common a WHERE a.crm_act_related_model = #{params.relatedModel} AND a.crm_act_related_id = #{params.relatedId} AND a.crm_act_type = 'task' AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date ASC NULLS LAST, a.crm_act_date DESC

name:zh-CN: 按直接关联对象查时间线
description: Get all activities directly anchored to a workspace object via crm_act_related_model and crm_act_related_id
fromSql: SELECT a.*, a.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS crm_act_status, a.crm_act_ext->>'priority' AS crm_act_priority, NULLIF(a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date AS crm_act_due_date, a.crm_act_ext->>'assignee' AS crm_act_assignee FROM mt_crm_activity_common a WHERE a.crm_act_related_model = #{params.relatedModel} AND a.crm_act_related_id = #{params.relatedId} AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY a.crm_act_date DESC

name:zh-CN: 按直接关联对象查任务评论
description: Get comment or note activities attached to task activities under one directly related workspace object
fromSql: SELECT c.pid, c.crm_act_type, c.crm_act_subject, c.crm_act_content, c.crm_act_date, c.crm_act_owner, c.crm_act_source, c.crm_act_parent_id, c.crm_act_files, c.crm_act_related_model, c.crm_act_related_id, p.crm_act_subject AS parent_task_subject, p.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS parent_task_status FROM mt_crm_activity_common c JOIN mt_crm_activity_common p ON p.pid = c.crm_act_parent_id AND p.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE p.crm_act_related_model = #{params.relatedModel} AND p.crm_act_related_id = #{params.relatedId} AND p.crm_act_type = 'task' AND c.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY c.crm_act_date DESC

description: Get all open tasks assigned to or owned by current user
fromSql: SELECT a.*, a.crm_act_ext->>'status' AS crm_act_status, a.crm_act_ext->>'priority' AS crm_act_priority, (a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate')::date AS crm_act_due_date FROM mt_crm_activity_common a WHERE a.crm_act_type = 'task' AND (a.crm_act_ext->>'assignee' = #{params.currentUserId} OR a.crm_act_owner = #{params.currentUserId}) AND a.crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY (a.crm_act_ext->>'dueDate')::date ASC NULLS LAST

description: All activities related to an account (direct + via contacts + via opportunities)
fromSql: SELECT DISTINCT a.*, r.crm_ar_object_type, r.crm_ar_role FROM mt_crm_activity_common a JOIN mt_crm_activity_relation_common r ON a.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND ((r.crm_ar_object_type = 'account' AND r.crm_ar_object_id = #{params.objectId}) OR (r.crm_ar_object_type = 'contact' AND r.crm_ar_object_id IN (SELECT pid FROM mt_crm_contact_common WHERE crm_ct_account_id = #{params.objectId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId})) OR (r.crm_ar_object_type = 'opportunity' AND r.crm_ar_object_id IN (SELECT pid FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_account_id = #{params.objectId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}))) ORDER BY a.crm_act_date DESC

description: Lead counts grouped by status for pipeline overview
fromSql: SELECT crm_lead_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_lead_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_lead_status ORDER BY count DESC

description: Opportunity counts and total amounts grouped by stage
fromSql: SELECT crm_opp_stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) AS total_amount FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_opp_stage ORDER BY CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'prospecting' THEN 1 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 2 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 3 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 4 WHEN 'closed_won' THEN 5 WHEN 'closed_lost' THEN 6 ELSE 7 END

description: Overall CRM KPI: total leads, open opportunities, won revenue, active accounts, pending complaints, and pending quote summaries
fromSql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_lead_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS total_leads, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_lead_common WHERE crm_lead_status = 'new' AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS new_leads, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS open_opportunities, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS pipeline_value, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_stage = 'closed_won' AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS won_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_account_common WHERE crm_acc_status = 'active' AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS active_accounts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE crm_cmp_status IN ('new', 'investigating') AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS pending_complaints, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_quote_summary_common WHERE crm_qs_status IN ('draft', 'pricing', 'approval') AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS pending_quotes

description: Recent CRM activities across all objects for dashboard
fromSql: SELECT a.pid, a.crm_act_type, a.crm_act_subject, a.crm_act_date, a.crm_act_owner, a.crm_act_source, r.crm_ar_object_type FROM mt_crm_activity_common a LEFT JOIN mt_crm_activity_relation_common r ON a.pid = r.crm_ar_activity_id AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY a.crm_act_date DESC LIMIT 20

description: Fetch leads with activity counts for AI scoring. Supports unscoredOnly filter.
fromSql: SELECT l.pid, l.crm_lead_company AS company, l.crm_lead_contact_name AS contact_name, l.crm_lead_source AS source, l.crm_lead_industry AS industry, l.crm_lead_status AS status, l.crm_lead_requirement AS requirement, l.crm_lead_score AS current_score, COALESCE(act.activity_count, 0) AS activity_count, act.last_activity_date FROM mt_crm_lead_common l LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.crm_ar_object_id, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, MAX(a.crm_act_date) AS last_activity_date FROM mt_crm_activity_relation_common r JOIN mt_crm_activity_common a ON r.crm_ar_activity_id = a.pid AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE r.crm_ar_object_type = 'lead' AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY r.crm_ar_object_id) act ON l.pid = act.crm_ar_object_id WHERE l.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND (#{params.unscoredOnly} IS NULL OR #{params.unscoredOnly} = '' OR l.crm_lead_score IS NULL) ORDER BY l.created_at DESC

description: Fetch new leads whose latest related activity is older than the supplied staleBefore timestamp, or that have no related activity. Use leadKeyword to narrow company/contact names.
fromSql: SELECT l.pid, l.crm_lead_company AS company, l.crm_lead_contact_name AS contact_name, l.crm_lead_source AS source, l.crm_lead_industry AS industry, l.crm_lead_status AS status, COALESCE(act.activity_count, 0) AS activity_count, act.last_activity_date FROM mt_crm_lead_common l LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.crm_ar_object_id, COUNT(*) AS activity_count, MAX(a.crm_act_date) AS last_activity_date FROM mt_crm_activity_relation_common r JOIN mt_crm_activity_common a ON r.crm_ar_activity_id = a.pid AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE r.crm_ar_object_type = 'lead' AND r.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY r.crm_ar_object_id) act ON l.pid = act.crm_ar_object_id WHERE l.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND l.crm_lead_status = 'new' AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR l.crm_lead_company ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%') OR l.crm_lead_contact_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.leadKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND (act.last_activity_date IS NULL OR act.last_activity_date < CAST(#{params.staleBefore} AS timestamp)) ORDER BY act.last_activity_date ASC NULLS FIRST, l.created_at DESC

description: Aggregate statistics for a specific account: opportunity count, won amount, quote summary count, complaint count
fromSql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS open_opportunities, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE crm_opp_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND crm_opp_stage = 'closed_won' AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS won_revenue, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_quote_summary_common WHERE crm_qs_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS total_quotes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE crm_cmp_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS total_complaints, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mt_crm_contact_common WHERE crm_ct_account_id = #{params.accountId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) AS total_contacts

description: Lead count grouped by source for pie/bar chart
fromSql: SELECT crm_lead_source AS label, COUNT(*) AS value FROM mt_crm_lead_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_lead_source IS NOT NULL GROUP BY crm_lead_source ORDER BY value DESC

description: Opportunity creation trend over last 6 months with count and total amount
fromSql: SELECT TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount::numeric), 0) AS total_amount FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 months' GROUP BY TO_CHAR(created_at, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month ASC

description: Win vs Loss counts for closed opportunities
fromSql: SELECT crm_opp_stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY crm_opp_stage

description: Pipeline forecast: opportunity count, total amount, and weighted forecast grouped by stage
fromSql: SELECT crm_opp_stage AS stage, COUNT(*) AS opportunity_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(AVG(crm_opp_probability), 0) AS avg_probability, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(crm_opp_probability, CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100), 0) AS weighted_forecast FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY crm_opp_stage ORDER BY CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 1 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 2 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 3 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

description: Pipeline forecast grouped by expected close month for timeline visualization
fromSql: SELECT TO_CHAR(crm_opp_expected_close_date, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS opportunity_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(crm_opp_probability, CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100), 0) AS weighted_forecast FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND crm_opp_expected_close_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY TO_CHAR(crm_opp_expected_close_date, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month

description: Pipeline forecast grouped by opportunity owner for team comparison
fromSql: SELECT COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, o.crm_opp_owner, 'Unassigned') AS owner_name, COUNT(*) AS opportunity_count, COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(o.crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(o.crm_opp_probability, CASE o.crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100), 0) AS weighted_forecast FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common o LEFT JOIN ab_user u ON o.crm_opp_owner = u.pid WHERE o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY COALESCE(u.nick_name, u.user_name, o.crm_opp_owner, 'Unassigned') ORDER BY weighted_forecast DESC

description: Aggregated forecast KPIs: total pipeline, weighted forecast, win rate, avg deal size
fromSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN crm_opp_expected_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_pipeline, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(crm_opp_probability, CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS weighted_forecast, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage = 'closed_won' THEN crm_opp_expected_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS won_revenue, CASE WHEN COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN 1 END) > 0 THEN ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage = 'closed_won' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN 1 END), 4) ELSE 0 END AS win_rate, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN crm_opp_expected_amount END), 0) AS avg_deal_size, COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won','closed_lost') THEN 1 END) AS open_deals FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}

description: Detailed list of open opportunities with weighted forecast for forecast table view
fromSql: SELECT o.pid, o.crm_opp_name, o.crm_opp_stage, o.crm_opp_expected_amount, o.crm_opp_probability, COALESCE(o.crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(o.crm_opp_probability, CASE o.crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100, 0) AS weighted_amount, o.crm_opp_expected_close_date, COALESCE(a.crm_acc_name, 'N/A') AS account_name FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common o LEFT JOIN mt_crm_account_common a ON o.crm_opp_account_id = a.pid AND a.tenant_id = o.tenant_id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') ORDER BY weighted_amount DESC

description: Email log counts grouped by status: sent, delivered, opened, bounced, failed
fromSql: SELECT crm_el_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_email_log WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_el_status ORDER BY count DESC

description: Aggregated metrics for a specific campaign: total members, leads, emails, avg rates
fromSql: SELECT members.total_members, COALESCE(SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_leads_generated), 0) AS total_leads, COALESCE(SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_emails_sent), 0) AS total_emails, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(metrics.crm_cmet_open_rate), 0), 1) AS avg_open_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(metrics.crm_cmet_click_rate), 0), 1) AS avg_click_rate, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(metrics.crm_cmet_conversion_rate), 0), 1) AS avg_conversion_rate, COALESCE(SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_cost), 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, CASE WHEN SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_cost) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_revenue) - SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_cost)) / SUM(metrics.crm_cmet_cost) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS overall_roi FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_members FROM mt_crm_campaign_member WHERE crm_cm_campaign_id = #{params.campaignId} AND tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}) members LEFT JOIN mt_crm_campaign_metric metrics ON metrics.crm_cmet_campaign_id = #{params.campaignId} AND metrics.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY members.total_members

description: Campaign performance grouped by campaign type: total cost, revenue, ROI, lead count
fromSql: SELECT c.crm_cpn_type AS campaign_type, COUNT(DISTINCT c.pid) AS campaign_count, COALESCE(SUM(m.crm_cmet_cost), 0) AS total_cost, COALESCE(SUM(m.crm_cmet_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue, CASE WHEN SUM(m.crm_cmet_cost) > 0 THEN ROUND((SUM(m.crm_cmet_revenue) - SUM(m.crm_cmet_cost)) / SUM(m.crm_cmet_cost) * 100, 1) ELSE 0 END AS roi, COALESCE(SUM(m.crm_cmet_leads_generated), 0) AS total_leads FROM mt_crm_campaign c LEFT JOIN mt_crm_campaign_metric m ON c.pid = m.crm_cmet_campaign_id AND m.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE c.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY c.crm_cpn_type ORDER BY roi DESC

description: Complaint counts grouped by SLA status for service desk dashboard
fromSql: SELECT COALESCE(crm_cmp_sla_status, 'none') AS sla_status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_cmp_status IN ('open', 'investigating') GROUP BY crm_cmp_sla_status ORDER BY count DESC

description: Average hours for first response and full resolution across complaints
fromSql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (crm_cmp_first_response_at - crm_cmp_date)) / 3600), 1) AS avg_response_hours, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN crm_cmp_resolution_date IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (crm_cmp_resolution_date - crm_cmp_date)) / 3600 END), 1) AS avg_resolution_hours, COUNT(CASE WHEN crm_cmp_sla_status = 'breached' THEN 1 END) AS breach_count, COUNT(*) AS total_complaints FROM mt_crm_complaint WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId}

description: Count of email templates grouped by category and status
fromSql: SELECT crm_et_category AS category, crm_et_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM mt_crm_email_template WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_et_category, crm_et_status ORDER BY category, status

description: Open-pipeline forecast grouped by the manager-set forecast category (commit / best_case / pipeline / omitted), independent of stage. Sums expected and weighted amounts per category for the forecast board pivot.
fromSql: SELECT COALESCE(crm_opp_forecast_category, 'pipeline') AS forecast_category, COUNT(*) AS opportunity_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS total_amount, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount * COALESCE(crm_opp_probability, CASE crm_opp_stage WHEN 'discovery' THEN 10 WHEN 'qualification' THEN 25 WHEN 'proposal' THEN 50 WHEN 'negotiation' THEN 75 ELSE 10 END) / 100), 0) AS weighted_forecast FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') GROUP BY COALESCE(crm_opp_forecast_category, 'pipeline') ORDER BY weighted_forecast DESC

description: Open opportunities (not closed_won/closed_lost) that have not been updated since the supplied staleBefore timestamp — i.e. stuck in their current stage. Use oppKeyword to narrow opportunity/account names. Drives the stage-stall early-warning list.
fromSql: SELECT o.pid, o.crm_opp_code AS code, o.crm_opp_name AS name, COALESCE(a.crm_acc_name, '') AS account_name, o.crm_opp_stage AS stage, o.crm_opp_owner AS owner, o.crm_opp_expected_amount AS expected_amount, o.updated_at AS last_updated, EXTRACT(DAY FROM (now() - o.updated_at))::int AS days_in_stage FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common o LEFT JOIN mt_crm_account_common a ON o.crm_opp_account_id = a.pid AND a.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} WHERE o.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND o.crm_opp_stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost') AND (COALESCE(CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '') = '' OR o.crm_opp_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '%') OR a.crm_acc_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', CAST(#{params.oppKeyword} AS text), '%')) AND o.updated_at < CAST(#{params.staleBefore} AS timestamp) ORDER BY o.updated_at ASC

description: Distribution of closed_lost opportunities by lost-reason code, with count and total lost amount. Drives the win/loss board's loss-analysis chart.
fromSql: SELECT COALESCE(crm_opp_lost_reason_code, 'other') AS lost_reason, COUNT(*) AS lost_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_opp_expected_amount), 0) AS lost_amount FROM mt_crm_opportunity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_opp_stage = 'closed_lost' GROUP BY COALESCE(crm_opp_lost_reason_code, 'other') ORDER BY lost_count DESC

description: Manager review queue over generic CRM customer requests. Aggregates pipeline amount, lightweight quote summaries, approval cases, and direct task risk without depending on any industry-specific quote or BOM model.
fromSql: SELECT cr.pid, cr.crm_cr_code, cr.crm_cr_title, cr.crm_cr_account_id, cr.crm_cr_opportunity_id, cr.crm_cr_priority, cr.crm_cr_status, cr.crm_cr_route_status, cr.crm_cr_expected_date, cr.crm_cr_owner, opp.crm_opp_name AS crm_mw_opp_name, opp.crm_opp_stage AS crm_mw_opp_stage, opp.crm_opp_expected_amount AS crm_mw_opp_expected_amount, opp.crm_opp_expected_close_date AS crm_mw_opp_expected_close_date, COALESCE(qs.quote_count, 0) AS crm_mw_quote_count, COALESCE(qs.quote_amount, 0) AS crm_mw_quote_amount, qs.latest_quote_valid_until AS crm_mw_latest_quote_valid_until, COALESCE(apc.pending_approval_count, 0) AS crm_mw_pending_approval_count, COALESCE(tasks.open_task_count, 0) AS crm_mw_open_task_count, COALESCE(tasks.overdue_task_count, 0) AS crm_mw_overdue_task_count, CASE WHEN cr.crm_cr_route_status = 'failed' THEN 'route_failed' WHEN COALESCE(apc.pending_approval_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'approval_pending' WHEN COALESCE(tasks.overdue_task_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'task_overdue' WHEN cr.crm_cr_expected_date IS NOT NULL AND cr.crm_cr_expected_date < CURRENT_DATE AND cr.crm_cr_status NOT IN ('won', 'lost', 'cancelled') THEN 'request_overdue' WHEN COALESCE(qs.quote_count, 0) = 0 AND cr.crm_cr_status IN ('routed', 'in_progress', 'quoted') THEN 'quote_missing' ELSE 'watch' END AS crm_mw_risk_reason, (CURRENT_DATE - cr.created_at::date) AS crm_mw_age_days FROM mt_crm_customer_request_common cr LEFT JOIN mt_crm_opportunity_common opp ON opp.pid = cr.crm_cr_opportunity_id AND opp.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_qs_customer_request_id AS request_id, COUNT(*) AS quote_count, COALESCE(SUM(crm_qs_quote_amount), 0) AS quote_amount, MAX(crm_qs_valid_until) AS latest_quote_valid_until FROM mt_crm_quote_summary_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_qs_customer_request_id) qs ON qs.request_id = cr.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_apc_customer_request_id AS request_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_apc_status = 'pending') AS pending_approval_count FROM mt_crm_approval_case_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} GROUP BY crm_apc_customer_request_id) apc ON apc.request_id = cr.pid LEFT JOIN (SELECT crm_act_related_id AS request_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress')) AS open_task_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE crm_act_ext->>'status' IN ('open', 'in_progress') AND NULLIF(crm_act_ext->>'dueDate', '')::date < CURRENT_DATE) AS overdue_task_count FROM mt_crm_activity_common WHERE tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} AND crm_act_type = 'task' AND crm_act_related_model = 'crm_customer_request_common' GROUP BY crm_act_related_id) tasks ON tasks.request_id = cr.pid WHERE cr.tenant_id = #{params.tenantId} ORDER BY COALESCE(apc.pending_approval_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(tasks.overdue_task_count, 0) DESC, cr.crm_cr_expected_date ASC NULLS LAST, cr.created_at DESC
